g.text: Online control pipeline and measured feedback
Fresh measured anchors at each re-grip
Per-arm control instance (x2) | position in mm, orientation from rotations
RangedIK v7 direct drives the arm. Optional gripper PI requires an external position sensor; the demonstrations use direct PWM.
